```{=html}
<style>
/* the DAW lessons: apps/shared/daw/mini-daw.js makes a DAW in every <div class="mdaw"> */
.mdaw{border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:10px;background:var(--site-surface);padding:.6rem .8rem .8rem;margin:1.1rem 0 1.8rem;outline:none;color:var(--site-ink)}
.mdaw [hidden]{display:none!important}
.mdaw:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--site-accent)}
.mdaw .btn{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.78rem;padding:.12rem .45rem}
.mdaw .btn.mdaw-on{background:var(--site-accent-dk);border-color:var(--site-accent-dk);color:#fff}
.mdaw .btn.mdaw-recon,.mdaw .mdaw-rec:hover{background:#c0302a;border-color:#c0302a;color:#fff}
.mdaw-transport,.mdaw-tools{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:.35rem .5rem;margin:.2rem 0 .5rem}
.mdaw-transport{padding-bottom:.5rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--site-border)}
.mdaw-pos{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:1rem;min-width:4.5rem;text-align:center;padding:.05rem .4rem;border-radius:4px;background:#1e1b18;color:#9fe3a0}
.mdaw-lbl{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--site-ink-2);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.25rem;margin:0}
.mdaw input[type=number]{width:3.8rem;font-size:.85rem;padding:.05rem .25rem;border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:4px;background:var(--site-surface);color:var(--site-ink)}
.mdaw input[type=text]{min-width:14rem;font-size:.85rem;padding:.1rem .35rem;border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:4px;background:var(--site-surface);color:var(--site-ink)}
.mdaw select{font-size:.8rem;padding:.05rem .2rem;border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:4px;background:var(--site-surface);color:var(--site-ink);max-width:12rem}
.mdaw-wide{flex:1 1 16rem}.mdaw-wide input{flex:1}
.mdaw-status{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--site-ink-2);flex:1 1 10rem}
.mdaw-hint{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--site-ink-2);margin:.35rem 0 0}
.mdaw-sub{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.75rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--site-ink-2);margin:.8rem 0 .3rem}
/* arrangement */
.mdaw-grid{position:relative;overflow-x:auto;border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:6px}
.mdaw-row{display:flex;min-height:46px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--site-border);width:max-content;min-width:100%}
.mdaw-row:last-of-type{border-bottom:0}
.mdaw-th{flex:0 0 196px;width:196px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:.2rem .35rem;border-left:5px solid transparent;border-right:1px solid var(--site-border);background:var(--site-surface);position:sticky;left:0;z-index:3;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.15rem}
.mdaw-selrow .mdaw-th{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--site-accent) 14%,var(--site-surface))}
.mdaw-corner{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.7rem;color:var(--site-ink-2);justify-content:center}
.mdaw-name{font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--site-ink);padding:0;width:100%}
.mdaw-thline{display:flex;gap:.2rem;align-items:center}
.mdaw-thline select{flex:1;min-width:0}
.mdaw .btn.mdaw-ms{font-size:.68rem;padding:0 .3rem;line-height:1.3}
.mdaw .btn.mdaw-mute{background:#d08a1a;border-color:#d08a1a;color:#fff}
.mdaw .btn.mdaw-solo{background:#2a7ac0;border-color:#2a7ac0;color:#fff}
.mdaw-lane{position:relative;flex:0 0 auto;min-height:46px;background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--site-border) 0 1px,transparent 1px var(--mdaw-bar,104px));cursor:copy}
.mdaw-rulerrow{min-height:22px}
.mdaw-zoom{display:inline-flex;gap:.2rem;align-items:center}.mdaw-projects input[type=text]{min-width:12rem}
.mdaw-ruler{min-height:22px;cursor:pointer;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--site-ink) 6%,transparent)}
.mdaw-bar{position:absolute;top:3px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.68rem;padding-left:3px;color:var(--site-ink-2);pointer-events:none}
.mdaw-loop{position:absolute;bottom:0;height:7px;background:var(--site-ink-2);opacity:.3;border-radius:2px;pointer-events:none}
.mdaw-loop.mdaw-loopon{background:#d0a21a;opacity:.9}
/* data-panels: folding, movable panels in two columns (panels.js); the position readout box */
.mdaw-posin{width:5.5rem;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:1rem;text-align:center;border:2px solid var(--site-accent);border-radius:4px}
.mdaw-shake{animation:mdaw-shake .35s}@keyframes mdaw-shake{20%,60%{transform:translateX(-4px)}40%,80%{transform:translateX(4px)}}
.mdaw-panelbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.35rem .5rem;align-items:center;margin:.5rem 0 .2rem}
.mdaw-cols{display:flex;gap:.9rem;align-items:flex-start;margin-top:.5rem}
.mdaw-colA,.mdaw-colB{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.6rem;min-width:0}
.mdaw-colA{flex:1 1 0}.mdaw-colB{flex:0 0 min(27rem,38%)}
.mdaw-colB.pc-empty{display:none}body.pc-moving .mdaw-colB.pc-empty{display:flex;min-height:6rem}
details.mdaw-panel{border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:8px;padding:.3rem .6rem .5rem;background:var(--site-surface)}
details.mdaw-panel>summary{cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.78rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--site-ink-2);padding:.1rem 0}
details.mdaw-panel:has(>:not(summary)[hidden]){display:none}
.mdaw-panel .mdaw-arr,.mdaw-panel .mdaw-editor,.mdaw-panel .mdaw-mixer,.mdaw-panel .mdaw-band,.mdaw-panel .mdaw-trackpanel,.mdaw-panel .mdaw-session{margin:0}
@media (max-width:900px){.mdaw-cols{flex-direction:column}.mdaw-colB{flex:none;width:100%}}
/* data-nav: the loop as a full-height region with two wide handles (nav-tools.js) */
.mdaw-nav .mdaw-rulerrow,.mdaw-nav .mdaw-ruler{min-height:32px}
.mdaw-nav .mdaw-loop.mdaw-loopr{top:0;bottom:0;height:auto;pointer-events:auto;cursor:grab;opacity:1;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--site-ink-2) 20%,transparent);border:1px solid var(--site-ink-2);border-radius:3px}
.mdaw-nav .mdaw-loop.mdaw-loopr.mdaw-loopon{background:rgba(208,162,26,.35);border-color:#d0a21a}
.mdaw-nav .mdaw-loop-h{position:absolute;top:-1px;bottom:-1px;width:14px;cursor:ew-resize;background-color:var(--site-ink-2);border-radius:3px;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 3px,rgba(255,255,255,.7) 3px 4px,transparent 4px 7px,rgba(255,255,255,.7) 7px 8px,transparent 8px)}
.mdaw-nav .mdaw-loopon .mdaw-loop-h{background-color:#d0a21a}
.mdaw-nav .mdaw-loop-l{left:-5px}.mdaw-nav .mdaw-loop-r{right:-5px}
.mdaw-clip{position:absolute;top:4px;bottom:4px;border-radius:4px;cursor:grab;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.mdaw-clip.mdaw-selclip{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--site-ink),inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.mdaw-mini{position:absolute;left:0;top:2px;pointer-events:none}
.mdaw-grip{position:absolute;right:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:7px;cursor:ew-resize;background:rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.mdaw-head{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:#e03a2a;pointer-events:none;z-index:2}
/* editor */
.mdaw-editor{margin-top:.8rem}
.mdaw-edtitle{font-weight:600;font-size:.9rem;margin-right:.4rem}
.mdaw-rollwrap{display:flex;max-height:21rem;overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:6px;position:relative}
.mdaw-keys{position:sticky;left:0;z-index:2;flex:0 0 5.2rem;background:var(--site-surface);border-right:1px solid var(--site-border)}
.mdaw-key{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.62rem;line-height:1;display:flex;align-items:center;padding-left:.3rem;border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--site-border) 50%,transparent);cursor:pointer;box-sizing:border-box}
.mdaw-key.mdaw-black{background:#2a2622;color:#ddd}
.mdaw-key.mdaw-vlab{cursor:default;color:var(--site-ink-2)}
.mdaw-rollscroll{flex:0 0 auto}
.mdaw-cv{display:block;cursor:crosshair;touch-action:none}
.mdaw-num{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.75rem;min-width:2.2rem;display:inline-block}
/* mixer */
.mdaw-strips{display:flex;gap:.5rem;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:.3rem}
.mdaw-strip{flex:0 0 6.4rem;border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-top:4px solid var(--site-ink-2);border-radius:6px;padding:.3rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.25rem;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--site-ink) 3%,var(--site-surface))}
.mdaw-strip:last-child{border-top-color:var(--site-ink);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--site-ink) 7%,var(--site-surface))}
.mdaw-sname{font-size:.75rem;font-weight:600;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.mdaw-pan{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;font-size:.65rem;color:var(--site-ink-2);margin:0;width:100%}
.mdaw-pan input{width:100%}
.mdaw-ghost{visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.mdaw-loopc{position:absolute;right:0;top:0;width:13px;height:13px;cursor:alias;z-index:2;background:linear-gradient(225deg,rgba(255,255,255,.85) 0 45%,transparent 46%);border-top-right-radius:4px}
.mdaw-loopc:hover{background:linear-gradient(225deg,#fff 0 55%,transparent 56%)}
.mdaw-loopg{position:absolute;top:2px;bottom:2px;border:2px dashed var(--site-accent-dk);border-radius:4px;opacity:.7;pointer-events:none;z-index:1}
.mdaw-cell.mdaw-ccur{outline:2px dashed var(--site-accent-dk);outline-offset:-2px}
.mdaw-fadwrap{display:flex;gap:.35rem;height:9rem;align-items:stretch}
.mdaw-fader{writing-mode:vertical-lr;direction:rtl;width:1.4rem;height:100%;accent-color:var(--site-accent-dk)}
.mdaw-meter{position:relative;width:.55rem;background:#1e1b18;border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden}
.mdaw-mfill{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:#4caf50}
.mdaw-mfill.mdaw-hot{background:linear-gradient(to top,#4caf50 0 80%,#e0b020 80% 93%,#e0402a 93%)}
.mdaw-mpeak{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:#fff}
.mdaw-clipled{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.6rem;padding:0 .3rem;border-radius:3px;background:#3a2a2a;color:#a88;cursor:pointer}
.mdaw-clipled.mdaw-over{background:#e0402a;color:#fff}
.mdaw-in{display:inline-block;width:5rem;height:.6rem;background:#1e1b18;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:middle}
.mdaw-infill{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:#4caf50}.mdaw-infill.mdaw-hot{background:#e0402a}
.mdaw-take{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.8rem;margin:.3rem 0}
.mdaw-audioed{max-height:none}
.mdaw-band{margin-top:.6rem;padding-top:.3rem;border-top:1px dashed var(--site-border)}
.mdaw-files{margin-top:.7rem;padding-top:.5rem;border-top:1px dashed var(--site-border)}
/* session view: apps/shared/daw/session.js */
.mdaw-views{display:flex;gap:.3rem;margin:.2rem 0 .5rem}
.mdaw-sgrid{display:grid;gap:3px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:.2rem}
.mdaw-sc{box-sizing:border-box;padding:.2rem .35rem;border-radius:5px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--site-ink) 5%,var(--site-surface));min-width:0}
.mdaw-scorner{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.7rem;color:var(--site-ink-2);display:flex;align-items:center}
.mdaw-shead{border-top:4px solid var(--site-ink-2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:.2rem}
.mdaw-sname{font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.mdaw-scene{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.25rem}
.mdaw-scene.mdaw-splay{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--site-accent)}
.mdaw-scene .mdaw-name{flex:1;min-width:0;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:3px;padding:0 .2rem}
.mdaw-scene .mdaw-name:focus{border-color:var(--site-border)}
.mdaw .btn.mdaw-scgo{font-size:.8rem;padding:0 .35rem}
.mdaw-roots{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.2rem;align-items:center}
.mdaw-rlbl{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.62rem;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--site-ink-2);margin-right:.1rem}
.mdaw-root{display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;min-width:2rem;padding:.05rem .3rem;border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:4px;background:var(--site-surface);color:var(--site-ink);cursor:pointer;line-height:1.1}
.mdaw-root:hover{border-color:var(--site-accent)}
.mdaw-rest{cursor:default;color:var(--site-ink-2)}
.mdaw-rname{font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem}.mdaw-rdeg{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.62rem;color:var(--site-ink-2)}
.mdaw-cell{position:relative;min-height:3.4rem;border-radius:5px;border:1px dashed var(--site-border);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.1rem;padding:.2rem .3rem .3rem 1.9rem;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;background:transparent}
.mdaw-cell.mdaw-has{border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.25);background:var(--cc);color:#fff}
.mdaw-cell.mdaw-na{opacity:.4;cursor:default}
.mdaw-cell.mdaw-csel{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--site-ink)}
.mdaw-cell.mdaw-cwait{animation:mdawblink .5s steps(2) infinite}
@keyframes mdawblink{50%{filter:brightness(1.45)}}
.mdaw-cell.mdaw-cplay{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #fff,0 0 0 2px var(--site-accent)}
.mdaw .btn.mdaw-launch{position:absolute;left:.25rem;top:.25rem;width:1.35rem;height:1.35rem;padding:0;line-height:1;border-radius:50%;font-size:.7rem;background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);color:#222}
.mdaw-empty .mdaw-launch{background:transparent;color:var(--site-ink-2)}
.mdaw-cell.mdaw-cplay .mdaw-launch{background:var(--site-accent-dk);color:#fff}
.mdaw-cname{font-size:.72rem;font-family:var(--font-mono)}
.mdaw-sthumb{width:100%;max-width:110px;height:22px}
.mdaw-prog{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;height:3px;width:0;background:#fff}
.mdaw-snone{padding:.4rem}
/* "in other DAWs" tables */
.daw-map{font-size:.88rem;overflow-x:auto;max-width:100%}
.daw-map th:first-child{white-space:nowrap}
.mdaw-trackpanel{margin-top:.8rem}.mdaw-tp{border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:6px;padding:.3rem .6rem .5rem;margin:.4rem 0}
.mdaw-tp-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1rem;align-items:flex-start}.mdaw-tp-side{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.3rem}
.mdaw-bars{display:flex;gap:.3rem}.mdaw-bar1{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.65rem;margin:0}
.mdaw-barin{writing-mode:vertical-lr;direction:rtl;height:5.5rem;width:1.3rem;accent-color:var(--site-accent-dk)}
.mdaw-chip{display:inline-block;font-size:.72rem;border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:10px;padding:0 .3rem;margin:.1rem .2rem 0 0}
.mdaw-fxslots{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;align-items:center;margin:.3rem 0}.mdaw-fxparams{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(11rem,1fr));gap:.3rem .8rem;margin:.4rem 0}
.mdaw-fxparams label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;font-size:.72rem;margin:0}.mdaw-fxparams input[type=range]{width:100%}
</style>
<script src="/apps/shared/soundfont.js?v=1"></script>
```
